@descriptorHolds_iff_residualTable_zero : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool),
  descriptorHolds d wv ↔ ∀ (b : Fin m → Bool), residualTable d wv enc b = 0
@gammaResidualTable_read : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6Q)
  (k : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length),
  gammaResidualTable d wv enc gamma (enc k) =
    gamma ^ ↑k * (algebraMap BabyBear Ext6Q) ((descriptorResiduals d wv).get k)
@honestRounds_boolean_sum : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6Q),
  descriptorHolds d wv →
    ∀ (r : Fin m → Ext6Q),
      ∀ i < m,
        Polynomial.eval 0 (honestRounds d wv enc gamma (chalOf r) i) +
            Polynomial.eval 1 (honestRounds d wv enc gamma (chalOf r) i) =
          scChain 0 (honestRounds d wv enc gamma (chalOf r)) (chalOf r) i
@honestRounds_closes_committed : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6Q),
  descriptorHolds d wv →
    ∀ (r : Fin m → Ext6Q) (opened : CommittedTerminal d wv enc gamma r),
      scChain 0 (honestRounds d wv enc gamma (chalOf r)) (chalOf r) m = opened.value
